experiments.study_type: Hepatocyte-specific Kctd17 depletion in mouse models of MASH
experiments.procedure_text: Cas9 knockin mice were transduced with AAV8-TBG-Cre (control) or AAV8-U6-sgKctd17-TBG-Cre (L-Kctd17) with an FPC diet and euthanized 16 weeks after transduction.

experiments.study_type: Pharmacologic Kctd17 inhibition in MASH-induced liver fibrosis
experiments.procedure_text: C57BL/6 WT mice were fed FPC diet for 10 weeks and then administered control ASO or two different Kctd17-targeting ASO weekly by intraperitoneal injection at 25 mg/kg.
